topic: Put a recurring task on autopilot with Cowork's /schedule
post:
What if your Friday report wrote itself before you got to your desk? ⏰
With Claude Cowork, you can set that up in a minute.

It's called a scheduled task.
You describe a job once, pick when it should run, and Claude does it automatically on that schedule.

How to set one up:

1️⃣ Open Cowork and start a task
2️⃣ Type /schedule
3️⃣ Describe the job and pick a cadence: hourly, daily, weekdays, weekly, or on demand

A great first one to try:
"Every Friday at 8 AM, summarize this week's project updates from my shared folder into a one-page status report: wins, risks, and next week's priorities."

You can see and manage everything under "Scheduled" in the left sidebar.

Other easy ideas:
☀️ A daily morning brief
📊 A weekly spreadsheet update
🗂️ Keeping a downloads folder tidy

Good to know: scheduled tasks are on paid Claude plans (Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise).

Why it matters:
The real time savings with AI come from the jobs you stop doing by hand, not just faster answers. Still give the first few runs a quick review.
